name: Mixed Model for Repeated Measures
label: MMRM
description: Linear mixed model for longitudinal data with structured R-side covariance. No random effects (G-side); within-subject correlation modeled through the residual covariance structure.

inputs.description: The response variable at each timepoint (e.g., change from baseline)
Continuous covariate(s) (e.g., baseline value, age, weight)
Timepoint/visit variable defining the repeated dimension

levels.name: repeated_factor_level
levels.description: A level of the repeated_factor variable

inputs.description: Treatment group (and optionally additional factors like region, sex)

levels.name: fixed_effect_level
levels.description: A level of the fixed_effect variable

inputs.description: Subject identifier for the repeated measures clustering

levels.name: repeated_subject_level
levels.description: A level of the repeated_subject variable

statisticalModel.name: MMRM model
statisticalModel.description: The part after '|' specifies the repeated measures structure: subject is the clustering unit, time is the repeated factor within subject. Multiple covariates and fixed effects are supported. The time:group interaction is typically the term of primary interest for treatment comparison at each visit.

formula.defaultExpression: response ~ covariate + repeated_factor + fixed_effect + repeated_factor:fixed_effect | repeated_subject / repeated_factor

parameters.name: repeated_factor_effect
parameters.description: Effect of a level of repeated_factor

parameters.name: repeated_factor_ls_mean
parameters.description: Estimated marginal mean for a level of repeated_factor

parameters.name: fixed_effect_effect
parameters.description: Effect of a level of fixed_effect

parameters.name: fixed_effect_ls_mean
parameters.description: Estimated marginal mean for a level of fixed_effect

parameters.name: fixed_effect_repeated_factor_interaction_effect
parameters.description: Effect of the interaction between fixed_effect and repeated_factor

forFactorLevelCombination.name: fixed_effect_repeated_factor_combination
forFactorLevelCombination.description: A combination of levels of the interacting factors of fixed_effect:repeated_factor

parameters.name: covariate_fixed_effect_interaction_effect
parameters.description: Effect of the interaction between covariate and fixed_effect

forFactorLevelCombination.name: covariate_fixed_effect_combination
forFactorLevelCombination.description: A combination of levels of the interacting factors of covariate:fixed_effect

modelTerms.name: repeated_subject
modelTerms.description: Conditioning structure defined by repeated_subject (strata or repeated subject)

parameters.name: repeated_subject_grouping
parameters.description: The grouping of observations by repeated_subject

subMethods.name: Basic fit statistics
subMethods.description: Basic model fit indices common to most likelihood-based models.

subMethods.name: Type III F-tests (mixed/multivariate)
subMethods.description: Type III F-tests for mixed and multivariate models (no SS/MS exposure).

subMethods.name: Least-squares means
subMethods.description: Least-squares means (adjusted marginal means) per factor level or level combination. Forms: ls_means_by_group_time (LS means for each group at each timepoint); ls_means_by_group (Marginal LS means averaged over time); ls_means_by_time (Marginal LS means averaged over group).

subMethods.name: T-based contrasts
subMethods.description: Contrasts from linear models with t-based inference. Forms: group_contrast_at_time (Group difference at a specific timepoint (e.g., Treatment vs Placebo at Week 24)); time_contrast_within_group (Change over time within a group (e.g., Week 24 vs Week 4 within Treatment)); overall_group_contrast (Overall group difference marginalized over time).

inputs.description: The estimated marginal means the contrast is formed from

subMethods.name: Covariance parameters
subMethods.description: Estimated covariance/variance components of the random-effects structure.
